slice: P2.4 consumed MLINESTYLE offset investigation and whole-source dependency blocker
scope: Locally authored AC1027 source, same-version ASCII/binary targets and source/target encoding controls. This investigates a changed offset on a style consumed by one model-space MLINE and one named-block MLINE; no production implementation was integrated.

authorities.notes: Style 70 bit 1 enables fill; bit 2 displays miters. The witness uses flags 2, uncut/open consumers and no fill/caps. Group 41 begins with signed distance along the miter, followed by segment/break parameters; group 42 represents fill parameters.

witness.geometry: Three non-collinear WCS vertices per consumer, distinct extrusion planes, scales 1.25 and 2.5, zero and bottom justifications; style offsets 1.25 and -0.75, with first offset edited to 1.5. Both consumers have no cuts or fill parameters. Independently checked group 41 against a signed perpendicular intersection equation and ezdxf 1.4.5 regenerated geometry. Not native CAD interpretation.
witness.limits: These physical/readback checks were run against an earlier scratch build, not the later source-bound regression executable. They show selected geometry only, not whole-document dependency, native rendering or support.

hiddenDependencyCounterexample.source: Locally authored simple source adds application data to LAYER: {TEST_HIDDEN, group 340 = D (the edited MLINESTYLE), }.
hiddenDependencyCounterexample.results: ASCII and binary source imports both succeed and the experimental consumed-offset write succeeds, despite no qualified interpretation of this opaque style dependency. The whole source identity observer retains 5/105 identity candidates, not complete 340/XDATA/embedded/proxy payloads; ordinary MLINE census skips non-MLINE records. Thus this is a concrete unsafe admission, not evidence of a supported application interpretation.
hiddenDependencyCounterexample.required: Keep the geometry prototype unintegrated until whole-source, field-role dependency evidence and a conservative validated admitted grammar reject this case.

scratchRegression.base: Shared source after d70643b2 and d62f9ff4; source and test files are private scratch, not a committed slice.
scratchRegression.result: PASS with experimental prototype; excludes whole-source safety and native semantics.
scratchRegression.atomicity: Refusal cases verify destination sentinel and absence of a published temporary file. Checks cover unchanged caller snapshots when no external hook mutates them; hook-mutated caller state is explicitly restored before retry. Transient restored mutation after a completed section is allowed when the already-emitted projection and subsequent validation remain valid. The finalizer is virtual; no guarantee is made for an override that skips its base validation.
scratchRegression.work: Per-record immutable snapshot check replaces the original per-consumer full census; full preflight, section and final validations remain. The newest design still needs aggregate work-budget boundary tests and compatibility review before integration.

nextWork: Add default-off bounded whole-read physical scalar evidence joined to accepted import, then a documented complete-source grammar rejecting unknown sections/records/fields, application/XDATA/proxy/embedded/binary payloads and unqualified references; qualify structural exceptions. Add the counterexample, quotas, failure/retry, output and compatibility controls before any geometry integration.
fixtures: All source drawings, peer outputs and test artifacts remain in ignored local scratch; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
